feeds.description: Repositories whose releases are announced, each in its own channel. The same repository may be listed twice (e.g. stable releases in one channel, pre-releases in another).

mentionRole.description: Role pinged with each announcement (nobody else is pinged). Leave empty for no ping.

label.description: Display name in the announcements (default: the repository, owner/name).

pollMinutes.description: How often each feed is checked, in minutes (5 to 1440). Without a GitHub token every check counts against GitHub's limit of 60 requests per hour per IP address: keep feeds × 60 / pollMinutes well under 60.

announceExisting.description: On the first check of a feed, announce its recent releases (at most 5 per check). Off: they are only recorded as seen, and only releases published afterwards are announced.
